name: Stormbringer: Undertow raises Drown's crit chance (#485, #1117)

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Drown (806408) has no crit modifier without Undertow
BASELINE: the Drown aura parent (806407) never carries the crit modifier
DISCRIMINATING: Undertow rank 1 (#485) adds +25% crit chance to Drown's damage effect (806408)
Undertow rank 1 still does not touch the aura parent (806407)
DISCRIMINATING: Undertow rank 2 (#1117) adds +50% crit chance to Drown's damage effect (806408)
Undertow rank 2 still does not touch the aura parent (806407)

contract: #485 and #1117: Undertow (705666 rank 1, 707796 rank 2) tooltips promise 'Increases the critical strike chance of Drown by $s2%.' Drown (806407) is a passive aura whose Effect[2] periodically triggers 806408, the SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE spell that actually deals Drown's damage; only 806408 carries the SpellFamilyFlags word-0 bit (0x00100000) that Undertow's SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE class mask targets. Undertow's Effect[1] is a stock ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (EffectBasePoints+EffectDieSides: rank 1 = 24+1 = 25, rank 2 = 49+1 = 50), applied through the engine's own Unit::SpellDoneCritChance -> Player::ApplySpellMod path with no module code involved. Both ranks are proven independently via unlearn/relearn so neither can be mistaken for the other or for a stacked 75%.
